exposure: Number of previous cesarean sections (3 groups)
cohort: 345 women undergoing repeat cesarean sections at Taleghani Hospital between April 2020 and June 2022
finding: The study found that while an increasing number of previous cesarean sections was significantly associated with longer surgery duration, higher rates of abnormal placental adhesion, and more intraperitoneal adhesions, it did not significantly impact other maternal or neonatal outcomes.
